# 7495 - 4-bit right-shift, left-shift register

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7495.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7495.json)

|---|---|---|
| ![7495 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7495.png) | ![7495 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-7495.png) | ![7495 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-7495.png) |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 13 | QA = stateA | Register stage A (QA is the stage the serial input enters). |
| 12 | QB = stateB | Register stage B (QA is the stage the serial input enters). |
| 11 | QC = stateC | Register stage C (QA is the stage the serial input enters). |
| 10 | QD = stateD | Register stage D (QA is the stage the serial input enters). |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 4

Changes on: falling edge of CK1 (MODE low) or of CK2 (MODE high)

- MODE high, CK2 high: hold
- MODE high, falling edge of CK2: QA QB QC QD = A B C D (parallel load; CK1 is ignored, serial entry is inhibited)
- Shift left = parallel load with QB wired to A, QC to B, QD to C, and serial data on D
- MODE low, CK1 high: hold
- MODE low, falling edge of CK1: QA = SER, QB = old QA, QC = old QB, QD = old QC (shift right; CK2 is ignored)
- Changes on MODE should be made while both clocks are low; the function table also shows hold for MODE rising with CK2 L CK1 L, MODE falling with CK2 L CK1 L, MODE falling with CK2 L CK1 H, MODE rising with CK2 H CK1 L, and MODE rising with CK2 H CK1 H

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CK1,CK2 | QA,QB,QC,QD | PLH | 18 | 27 |
| CK1,CK2 | QA,QB,QC,QD | PHL | 21 | 32 |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin | Against | Min ns | Min MHz | Typ MHz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| pulse width | CK1,CK2 |  | 20 |  |  |
| setup | SER,A,B,C,D | clock falling | 15 |  |  |
| hold | SER,A,B,C,D | clock falling | 0 |  |  |
| time to enable clock 1 | MODE | CK1 | 15 |  |  |
| time to enable clock 2 | MODE | CK2 | 15 |  |  |
| time to inhibit clock 1 | MODE | CK1 | 5 |  |  |
| time to inhibit clock 2 | MODE | CK2 | 5 |  |  |
| max clock frequency | CK1,CK2 |  |  | 25 | 36 |

## Notes

MODE is drawn as an input: it chooses which clock and which data path is used; it does not switch the outputs off. The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.

## Sources

- [TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 7 (MSI/LSI data sheets)](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1976_TI_The_TTL_Data_Book_2ed/07.pdf) - 7-89, 7-91 (PDF pages 88, 90); SN7495A (the 1976 book lists only the A version of the plain 74 part)
